comments.author: @luatND89
comments.text: From April to August is the dry season — the perfect time for sunny skies and beach adventures. From September to December comes the rainy and stormy season, when tropical storms may appear between warm, sunny days. Late December to the end of March is the cool season, when northern cold air sweeps in. During this time, there are no major storms, but sunny days are rare, and the weather is mostly overcast with light, chilly drizzles. Plan your trip wisely, and Da Nang will always be here to welcome you with open arms.
